title: Ev_Stock_Arrived event unassertable: absent from harness event vocabulary, no test asserts it
detail: The inventory-grant event (run.odin:165) has no demo/unit assertion, and the harness can't express one — valid_event_name + event_matches omit it. Inventory state is T1-pinned, so the mutation is covered; only the event payload isn't.
recommended_fix: Add a `stock_arrived` arm to valid_event_name + event_matches (Ev_Stock_Arrived), and a demo `expect event stock_arrived within ...` spanning a grant tick.

title: Scripted-demo `place_router` verb parsed/built but exercised by no demo
detail: The harness parses/builds place_router intents, but no demo uses the verb. Cmd_Place_Router is covered via autopilot (surge demo) + unit tests, so this demo-parse branch is unexercised (incl. its unknown-type empty-command fallback).
recommended_fix: Add a `place_router` line to a demo (e.g. draw_and_upgrade) asserting -> ok and -> out_of_routers, or drop the verb if scripted placement is out of scope.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (T1/T2/replay across 7 demos). P1 ~100% (inventory validate + draw/upgrade/demolish/QoS/surge/health/node-health/queue-overflow all unit+demo covered; node-health & queue-overflow tests are real pins). Overall >85%. Only P3 slivers open; --soak is manual dev tooling.
recommended_fix: Add the Ev_Stock_Arrived assertion arm + one scripted place_router demo to lift the two open P3 slivers to explicit pins.
